cohort: The study included 220 pregnant women whose allostatic load was assessed in the third trimester.
finding: High allostatic load in women during the third trimester was associated with an increased risk of delayed onset of lactogenesis (OR=1.90, 95%CI: 1.016-3.619, P = 0.043).
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was identified as an influential factor for delayed onset of lactogenesis (OR=2.51, 95%CI: 1.096-5.748, P = 0.029).
